content: Tauma Mamaitua na taunoyama be ka riu vavasaḡemina: Taumi Mamaitua na raukiviverema koya paḡona, be nam inam raukiviverenama ko voia yababena.

content.text: “Tauguḡa taumi ami raḡanima è boruna da yai yawasanimina.
Be inam raḡanine taugu ami ḡabama è vaie be è sagumina.”

content: Koya vaie, inam raḡaninama yodi ya tavana da Mamaitua vere e voiena ḡarode.
Tauma nam aiyaba gewegewedima kama voivoiedina da banaga tauma ama noyama ta riutuatuaḡaie, ibewa,
be yaba matabudi ka voivoiedina sibo banaga a kitamai be ai kawa riukauemai da tauma naumeki Mamaitua na taunoyama. Be raḡan matabuna tauma piripiri be gewagewa matabudi ka damidami poredina.
Banaga a riḡariḡamai, dibure a birimai, patara a ḡasiemai, kè bagibagi gurata, nam kena kaua, kani kè gurina. Inam yabedima matabudi kè dami poredina.
Tauma raḡan matabuna nam aba gewagewanama banaga ḡarodie ke voiena, ibewa. Be tauma raḡan matabuna Arua Babaue banaga kèi nuapaḡoedi be nuatauḡa raukiviveree kè noyanoyana.
Tauma raḡan matabuna Mamaitua na rewapanae riukaua kè rarau guguyena. Didimana vutuna tauma ama tuniḡaḡara be ama madama.

Banaga ḡesaudima ta viviviviremaina, be ḡesaudima nam tima viviviviremaina, ta kunukunuremaina be ḡesaudima isamaima ta kaikai suḡusuḡuna. Ḡesaudima ta riuriu waikaikaiyovuemaina, be yaḡoro tauma riukaue ka giugiuna.
Uma dobunama inam e nuanuababaḡemaina be Mamaitua e katakataiemaina. Raḡan matabuna guri ka kitakita saḡesaḡena, be yaḡoro ka miamiana. Banaga ta riḡariḡamaina be nam timawai gurimaina.

Banaga tawai nuaboyamaina be raḡan matabuna tauma kawai nuaverena. Tauma waikaruwaḡawaḡamaima, be banaga toitoi ka sagudi da tawai guyauna. Tauma nam waipurapuramai be yaḡoro yaba matabudi inam tauma ḡaromaima.
Taumi yau banagama Korint, taugu nam ḡaromie giu ei daḡasiena, ibewa da yau giuma didimanidie è giuemina. Taugu nopoguma è raḡa porena taumi ḡaromie.
Taugu nuaguma nam taumi ḡaromie ama guduguduna, be taumi taugu ḡarogue nuemima ko guduguduna.
Taumi yau sedama aubainama, yàwai baḡemina da taumi mate sibo nopomima koya kaiporena ḡarogue.
Banaga nam waisumeḡidi nam mate koi rawateḡeimi
Waisumaḡa banegimima nam kupi banegidima mate koi rawateḡeimi. Baninama vere nam gewagewa mate tai rawateḡeidi be teneteneḡina. Be yana nam kupi mate tai rawateḡeidi be teneteneḡina.
Be Keriso nam Seitan mate tai rawateḡeidi be teneteneḡina. Waisumaḡa banegidima nema kupi banegidima mate tai rawateḡei bakedi?
Be Mamaitua na vadama kokoitau mate nema tai rawateḡei bakedi? Be tauda Mamaitua yawayawasaninama na vadama, baninama tauna umanama ya riuna:

content.text: “Vutuna aubainama taumi kupi banegidima ko gosedi
inam raḡanine taugu tokare yài aninemina.”
Nama Bada wairewapana vavasaḡinama ya riuna.”
